## WorkspaceDocumentResourceClient.debug() method

Start a debugging session using the "run" or "run without building" scheme action. When several workspace documents share the same name, the first match in the app's order is used, and the operation does not fail as ambiguous.

**Signature:**

```typescript
debug(name: string, scheme?: string, runDestinationSpecifier?: string, skipBuilding?: boolean, commandLineArguments?: unknown, environmentVariables?: unknown, options?: CallOptions): Promise<void>;
```
